substantive_insights: Core tension was practical: D's bereavement-related unavailability vs. a fixed client deadline with D's partially completed section.
C explicitly lacked the skills to cover D's analysis ('I don't know how to do her analysis'), which limited internal alternatives and pushed toward D completing the work.
